name: Write Table
description: Fill a table from a list of records at a start cell: the header row, one row per record, registered as a real Excel table with a banded style so people get filtering and sorting for free. columns is optional — { header, field, width, numFmt } each; without it every field of the first record is a column. options: { name, style: 'TableStyleMedium2', stripes }.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const ws = workbook.getWorksheet(sheet) || workbook.addWorksheet(sheet || 'Sheet1'); const list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []; const cols = Array.isArray(columns) && columns.length ? columns : Object.keys(list[0] || {}).map((k) => ({ field: k, header: k })); const opts = options || {}; const startCell = ws.getCell(String(start || 'A1')); const name = String(opts.name || ('Table' + (Object.keys(ws.tables || {}).length + 1))).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, '_'); ws.addTable({ name, ref: startCell.address, headerRow: true, totalsRow: false, style: { theme: opts.style || 'TableStyleMedium2', showRowStripes: opts.stripes !== false }, columns: cols.map((c) => ({ name: String(c.header ?? c.field) })), rows: list.map((r) => cols.map((c) => { const v = r == null ? null : r[c.field ?? c.header]; return v === undefined ? null : v; })) }); cols.forEach((c, j) => { const col = ws.getColumn(startCell.col + j); if (c.width) col.width = +c.width; if (c.numFmt) for (let i = 1; i <= list.length; i++) ws.getCell(startCell.row + i, startCell.col + j).numFmt = String(c.numFmt); }); return workbook; })() }}"}]
